jobs.description:
ScioTeq is world leader in development and manufacturing of 
high-tech visualization solutions for the world’s most demanding sectors: 
Avionics, 
Air Traffic Control and 
Defense & Security markets.
 

 
 

As a member of the international sales team, the Key Account Manager Kongsberg 
nurtures an existing customer relationship and sales funnel, spread over multiple business divisions of Kongsberg Gruppen A.S.
 

 
 

Main region of focus will be Norway.
 

 
 

Supported by product management, program management, customer service and sales administration teams, the Key Account Manager is responsible for 
successfully implementing the ScioTeq sales strategy while working closely with Kongsberg procurement, program and technical teams to further enhance the existing funnel, close on current opportunities and deepen the existing collaboration.
 

 
 

Primary Responsibilities
 
 

•  

Further develop the account in line with the objectives set by the Senior Sales Director.
  

•  

Maintain and enhance 
commercial contact with existing customer base and manage the 
entire sales cycle, including product presentations, quotations and contractual negotiations.
  

•  

Establish sales 
action plans to achieve bookings and revenue targets.
  

•  

Manage and communicate progress against set targets via accurate and 
timely reporting, including forecasting via CRM.
  

•  

Assess 
competitive products, industry trends and identify market opportunities.
  

•  

Understand and live by ScioTeq’s 
ethics and business conduct policies.
  

•  

You report to the Sales Director Air Traffic Control, Defense & Security.
  
 

•  

You have a 
master’s degree in engineering or business (master’s degree in business, marketing, engineering or related field desirable) or equivalent by experience
  

•  

You have exceptional 
communication skills with the ability to deliver high-level presentations and communicate at C-Level within DoD/MoD and prime contractor base.
  

•  

You have at least 7 years of 
sales and marketing experience of multi-level selling in an international technical B2B environment.
  

•  

Military background or familiarity with the 
European defense landscape (military standards and specifications, government type contracts) is a definite plus.
  

•  

Proven track record of successful year-on-year business growth and demonstrated ability to 
close deals.
  

•  

Effective networking skills and capability to build strong customer relationships at all levels of organizational hierarchy.
  

•  

Comfortable with 
long sales cycles.
  

•  

Languages: proficiency in English is a minimum for this position. Obviously, proficiency in Norwegian and French is a definite plus.
  

•  

Ability to 
travel as required, up to 50% or more at given times.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company (re)packages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. They do this in a customized way for each client. By 2027, the company aims to have more than 300 employees working together on 25,000 unique packaging assignments.

Working at this company means working in a respectful environment where strong connection between employees and dedication to the work go hand in hand.

You are a key point of contact on the work floor and maintain an overview of the day-to-day logistics operations. At the same time, you take an active, hands-on role in the work yourself.

 
• 
You operate a forklift, reach truck and pallet truck and assist wherever needed.

 
• 
You maintain an overview of the logistics operations and organise the work to ensure everything runs smoothly.

 
• 
You guide and supervise colleagues in a clear and positive manner.

 
• 
You monitor safety, quality and the correct execution of all activities.

 
• 
You accurately scan labels and storage locations and ensure that all movements of goods are correctly registered.

 
• 
When deviations or unexpected situations occur, you respond quickly and take a practical approach to finding solutions.

 
• 
As a key point of contact on the work floor, you contribute to effective teamwork and cooperation.

 
• 
You help ensure that logistics operations are carried out efficiently and in an organised manner.

Ready to take responsibility, support your team and get the job done? You can read below what we are looking for.

 
• 
You have experience in a logistics or warehouse environment and are familiar with day-to-day warehouse operations.

 
• 
You have experience supervising, guiding or coordinating employees.

 
• 
Working hands-on alongside the team is an important part of this position and is something you are comfortable with.

 
• 
You have practical experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck and hold the required certificates.

 
• 
Experience with a pallet truck is an advantage, but not a requirement.

 
• 
You are able to maintain an overview, set priorities and adapt quickly when schedules or circumstances change.

 
• 
You communicate clearly with colleagues and are able to guide employees in a positive manner.

 
• 
You actively monitor safety and quality on the work floor.

 
• 
You communicate well in Dutch and English and have a basic knowledge of French. This is important because you will be supervising logistics employees who speak Dutch, English or French.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
This company repackages and stores frozen and chilled food products for numerous European businesses. These services are tailored to the specific needs of each customer. By 2025, the company aims to employ more than 300 people, who together handle 25,000 unique packaging orders. Working for this company means being part of a respectful environment where strong teamwork and dedication to the job go hand in hand.

You are the day-to-day point of contact on the production floor, making sure the team knows what needs to be done. You keep a close eye on both the employees and the production process.

Your main responsibilities will include:

 
• 
You lead and coach a team of approximately 15 employees within the manual packaging department.

 
• 
You organise the daily activities and ensure that operations run smoothly and efficiently.

 
• 
During production, you monitor quality, food safety and hygiene.

 
• 
You keep track of production planning and staffing levels and make adjustments when necessary.

 
• 
You identify operational bottlenecks and look for ways to improve efficiency and productivity.

 
• 
You motivate employees, provide feedback and address issues when necessary.

 
• 
You contribute to strong teamwork and a positive working atmosphere.

 
• 
You support new colleagues during their onboarding and training.

 
• 
You work closely with other departments and report on daily operations.

 
• 
When the situation requires it, you are happy to roll up your sleeves and work alongside the team on the production floor.

You keep a cool head when plans change and understand what your team needs to keep moving forward. You are visible and approachable on the production floor, provide clear direction and make adjustments where necessary. Sound like you? Then this could be your dream job!

 
• 
You have experience in the food industry, preferably within a production or packaging environment.

 
• 
Previous experience in a supervisory or team-leading role is a strong advantage.

 
• 
You know how to motivate and coach employees and provide clear, constructive feedback.

 
• 
You communicate clearly, respectfully and assertively.

 
• 
When organising the work, you take both quality and efficiency into account.

 
• 
You are able to set priorities and organise daily activities effectively.

 
• 
You take responsibility and show initiative.

 
• 
Changing circumstances sometimes require quick adjustments, and you are able to respond accordingly.

 
• 
You enjoy being present on the production floor and are willing to work alongside the team when needed.

 
• 
You work daytime hours, but are flexible when necessary.

 
• 
You have a good language of Dutch and English, allowing you to communicate effectively with colleagues and supervisors.

Join our team
 

We are a restaurant awarded 
1 Michelin star and are looking for a motivated and passionate 
cook to join our kitchen team.
 

Quality, product knowledge, precision and teamwork are at the heart of our kitchen. We work with high-quality ingredients every day and strive to offer our guests a gastronomic experience at the highest level.
 

As a cook, you will have an important role within our team and contribute to the daily operation of the kitchen.
 

As a cook, you will:

be responsible for your own section of the kitchen;
  

•  

prepare the mise en place and preparations for your section;
  

•  

prepare and plate dishes according to our standards;
  

•  

ensure consistent quality, taste and presentation;
  

•  

work closely with the chef and the rest of the kitchen team;
  

•  

ensure an efficient and well-organised service;
  

•  

work according to hygiene and HACCP standards;
  

•  

take proper care of ingredients, equipment and your workstation;
  

•  

actively contribute to the efficient organisation and operation of the kitchen.
  
 

•  

You have 
at least 2 years of relevant professional experience as a cook, or can demonstrate equivalent relevant knowledge and experience.
  

•  

You are organised and able to work accurately.
  

•  

You have a strong eye for detail, quality and presentation.
  

•  

You can work both independently and as part of a team.
  

•  

You speak 
Dutch or English.
  

•  

You are able to travel independently to the 
Knokke region, Belgium.

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

jobs.occupation: Oliver James Associates - Senior Azure / .NET Architect
jobs.description:
We're reimagining a mission-critical communication platform that powers how systems exchange data, files, and events with the outside world. This is not a greenfield toy project-it's a high-impact transformation at scale.

As a Senior Azure .NET Architect, you'll help design and shape a next-generation, cloud-native integration platform. You'll take an existing, complex ecosystem and turn it into a resilient, high-performance, event-driven architecture running on Azure.

If you enjoy solving hard distributed systems problems and building platforms that truly matter-this role is for you.
💡 What you'll be doing

You won't just "contribute"-you'll shape the future architecture:

• Design and build a modern communication layer handling message and file ingestion, transformation, routing, and delivery (sync + async)

• Create resilient, fault-tolerant systems using proven patterns like retries, circuit breakers, idempotency, and event-driven workflows

• Architect scalable event-driven solutions using Azure messaging services and/or Kafka-style pub/sub systems

• Build high-quality .NET services (.NET 7/8, C#, ASP.NET Core, gRPC/REST) with a strong engineering culture (TDD, clean code, performance-first)

• Deploy and operate workloads on Kubernetes (AKS/OpenShift) using Helm and modern CI/CD pipelines

• Define observability from day one: logging, tracing, metrics, SLOs, and actionable runbooks

• Collaborate in a truly agile setup, working closely with engineers, product owners, and other teams

• Mentor and elevate others-your experience will help raise the bar across the team

🎯 Why this role stands out

• High impact: You're building a core platform that everything depends on

• Real engineering challenges: Distributed systems, scalability, resilience-no trivial work here

• Modern tech stack: Cloud-native, Kubernetes, event-driven, .NET latest

• Ownership & influence: Your architectural decisions will shape the platform long-term

• Collaborative culture: Work with experienced engineers who care about doing things right

• Extensive experience in software engineering (15+ years), including building distributed, high-throughput, or mission-critical systems

• Strong hands-on Azure expertise (AKS, Functions, messaging services, Storage, monitoring, CI/CD)

• Deep knowledge of .NET (C#, modern .NET, async programming, testing practices)

• Solid understanding of event-driven architecture and distributed system trade-offs

• Experience with Docker and Kubernetes in production environments

• A mindset focused on quality, automation, and continuous improvement

• Confidence to make architectural decisions and guide others

• Strong communication skills in English

 

🌟 bonus points:

• Experience with observability stacks (Opentelemetry, tracing, logging platforms)

• Exposure to large-scale messaging or file transfer systems

• Knowledge of secure integration protocols (e.g., sFTP, AS2/AS4, messaging queues)

• Experience working in regulated or high-reliability environments

For an international, technology-driven company, we are looking for a Finance Analyst. In this role, you will combine financial analysis with in-depth cost analysis and project controlling. You will monitor the financial performance of international projects, analyse costs and profitability, and translate financial data into actionable insights for project management and senior management.  Finance Analyst - Responsibilities: 

• Financial analysis & project controlling: Analyse the financial performance of projects, monitor revenue, margins and profitability, and prepare forecasts and financial reports.
• Cost analysis & budget monitoring: Analyse project costs, resource allocation and budget variances. Investigate the drivers behind differences between budget, forecast and actual results, and recommend improvement actions.
• Forecasting & financial modelling: Prepare financial forecasts, estimate total project costs and expected results, and support complex financial analyses.
• Reporting & management information: Translate financial data into clear reports, variance analyses and presentations to support project managers and senior management in their decision-making.
• Risk & contract analysis: Identify financial risks and opportunities and assess the impact of contract changes on project costs, revenue and profitability.
• Financial project monitoring: Monitor budgets, funding and invoicing status, and collaborate with project management, finance, accounting and procurement to resolve financial matters.
• Financial accuracy & compliance: Ensure accurate financial processing and reporting in accordance with IFRS, internal controls and applicable company procedures.

Finance Analyst - Profile:

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Accountancy, Business Management or a related field, or have equivalent relevant experience.
• You have 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in finance.
• You have a strong affinity for financial analysis, cost analysis, budget monitoring and profitability calculations. You are able to investigate financial variances and translate them into actionable insights.
• You have advanced Excel skills and are comfortable analysing and structuring large volumes of financial data and developing financial models.
• You have a solid understanding of accounting principles and revenue recognition. Experience with percentage-of-completion revenue recognition is considered an asset.
• You communicate effectively with a variety of stakeholders, including project managers and senior management, and can present financial information in a clear and structured manner.
• You are fluent in English. Knowledge of Dutch is considered a plus.
• Knowledge of SAP, different contract types or government contracts is an asset.
